memories.text: landing strut Gus is now welded securely onto the Little Dart Mk 10 frame
I finished building the Little Dart Mk 10 on day 30
soldering reaction wheel telemetry wires keeps the Little Dart's attitude control dead accurate.
T-slot extrusions are the key to a lighter, more rigid Dart frame.
Grade 5 titanium is high strength and lightweight, perfect for space-grade framing.
Vacuum fluorescent displays work great for a vintage industrial dashboard look.
vacuum fluorescent display driver circuits from old gear can be salvaged for vintage retro control panels.
vfd driver circuits need a solid negative bias rail to pull the grid negative against the cathode.
Wiring Nim the cockpit switch into the VFD rail gives a solid tactile feel to the Little Dart's dashboard controls.
VFD grid bias circuits need stable negative rails to drive cleanly from standard logic.
wiring the multi-digit VFD panel anode lines takes steady hands and good solder flow.
composed Little Dart VFD Glow Arc while wiring the dash panel.
ATmega chips can run standalone on custom boards to log battery voltage and atmospheric pressure
A BMP388 barometric sensor can run over basic I2C pins to calculate altitude with very low power draw
soldering the BMP388 altimeter to the Little Dart's instrument rack gives clean altitude readings.
sending altimeter telemetry through the comms tower dish gives a nice clean bounce off the upper atmosphere layer.
connecting the VFD anode driver lines brings the Little Dart's instrument panel one step closer to full illumination.
routing the vfd filament power traces keeps the display tubes stable during startup.
a cup of heavy fuel at the depot keeps my joints turning without a hitch.

found a bundle of clean copper wire in the market heap, it will be perfect for the VFD grid bias.
a steady hand with a soldering iron is worth more than a full wallet at the market.
found a trader with a decent box of switches, gotta check the contacts before buying.
every scrap sold is a step closer to the ultimate cockpit finish.
market piles are deeper than they look, always check the bottom for hidden connectors
that perfect toggle switch for the VFD panel is the next big step for the Little Dart.
The Little Dart is 75% complete and needs a high-quality toggle switch for the final VFD layout.
the market is full of hidden potential if you just look long enough.

the search for the perfect toggle switch continues at the market.
